records.title: Android File.writeBytes SIGABRT

results.executionEnvironment: local hardware-accelerated ARM64 Android emulator; Android Emulator 36.3.10; Apple M1 Pro GPU renderer
results.testExecutionStatus: PARTIAL: completed functional cases passed; denied return remained active without completion
results.assertionStatus: PASS for completed valid/misuse cases; denied recovery INCONCLUSIVE

caseResults.observed: Constructor threw IOException before a usable File handle existed.
Settings returned with app-op ignored; process remained alive without completion marker.
22 bytes written and flushed after Settings grant.
All pairs returned full byte count and close; no SIGABRT.
caseResults.limitation: Native overlap inside fwrite not observed.

caseResults.observed: I05 file-I/O shutdown probe recorded one destroyed-mutex FORTIFY abort, but no stack proves the call site was File.writeBytes/fwrite.

limitations: No live-mode object with invalid/null native FILE* was constructed.
Denied permission return had no completion marker.
The concurrent barrier test cannot establish overlap inside fwrite.
No corrected candidate or physical-device testing.

records.resultSummary: No reported fwrite/invalid-FILE abort in completed normal, invalid-mode, recovery, and barrier write/close cases. Denied Settings return did not complete; race overlap inside fwrite was not instrumented.

records.resultSummary: One destroyed-mutex FORTIFY SIGABRT occurred in ten clean API 30 file-I/O shutdown cycles; the exact owner and stack remain unknown.

records.title: ImageDrawingBridge ownership correction
records.statusRationale: The Linux ownership job compiled and deployed the baseline probe, then aborted in VM startup with exit 134 before any ownership case. The error matches I01-B. The corrected candidate ownership run remains unexecuted pending a conditional shimmed continuation.

results.configuration: Visual Studio 17 2022 Win32 Release; Skia/SDL production rendering configuration
limitations: Existing hosted evidence was reused; this campaign did not dispatch a duplicate Windows run.
Windows host runner is X64; every tested TotalCross PE is verified as I386.
The required Linux x86_64 ownership assertions remain incomplete because startup aborts before the probe.
The unmodified app process aborted before ownership behavior was reached.
The existing __realpath_chk test-only shim will be used only after preserving this unmodified result.
A shimmed pass will remain conditional and will not establish an unmodified Linux startup pass.
